stem.en: An organism is microscopic, has no true nucleus and has a rigid cell covering. It survives high salinity and high temperature. Where does it belong, and why?

text.en: Monera: with no true nucleus, it is a prokaryote.

feedback.en: Right. No true nucleus is the test for Monera, wherever the organism lives.

text.en: Protista: every microscopic organism is placed here.

feedback.en: Protista holds unicellular organisms with a nucleus. This one has none.

text.en: Fungi: a rigid covering is the sign of a fungus.

feedback.en: Bacteria have rigid cell coverings too. The missing nucleus decides this one.

text.en: Plantae: only plant cells have a rigid covering.

feedback.en: A rigid covering is not limited to plants, and plants have a nucleus.

explanation.en: No true nucleus means a prokaryote, and prokaryotes are placed in Monera. Surviving in hot, salty water does not change that test.

hints.en: Which test comes first in the five kingdom system?
